Urban Heat Islands and Green Roofs: Evidence from Dhaka

Abstract

:
Green roofs are promoted to cool cities, but evidence from tropical megacities is scarce. Using satellite land surface temperature and 120 rooftop sensors in Dhaka, we found that green roofs lowered roof surface temperature by 12 °C and nearby air temperature by 0.8 °C on summer afternoons.
Keywords: green roofs; heat island
